title: Strong passphrases
intro: A password is the key to your accounts. Anyone who knows it can get in, play as you and even change things.
The strongest passwords are long. You can join a few random words into a funny phrase, like 'purple dragon eats pizza on the moon'.
A good password is also secret and different for every account. Only you and your parents know it.

game.prompt: Sort each password: strong or weak?

items.explain: It's one of the most common passwords in the world. A computer guesses it in a second.
Four random words make a long password that's hard to guess and easy to remember.
Friends and people online may know that name or guess it.

items.text: my turtle runs faster than a blue bus
items.explain: A long, odd sentence is a strong password, as long as you don't share it.
A common word with a number at the end is one of the first things attackers try.

items.text: A long, good password, but the same one in every game
items.explain: If one game gets hacked, all your other accounts are at risk. Every account gets its own password.

quiz.question: Which password is the strongest?
options: green cat drinks juice on the roof
quiz.explain: A few random words together make a long password that's hard to guess.

quiz.question: Why not use the same password everywhere?
options: Because if it leaks in one place, every account is at risk
quiz.explain: A different password for each account keeps the rest safe, even if one is hacked.

quiz.question: A good friend asks for your game password. What do you do?
options: Share it only if they promise to keep it secret
Don't. Only you and your parents know it
quiz.explain: Even good friends don't need your password. That way the account stays yours.

summary: A strong password is long, like a few random words together. It's different for every account, and only you and your parents know it.
